clauses.quote: DCPS and the WTU shall have the right, at their own expense, to legal and/or stenographic assistance at Step 3.
clauses.notes: Joint clause granting mutual right; protected_party assigned to worker as default for CBA mutual provision.

clauses.quote: Employees and the WTU shall follow the procedures in this Article regarding any grievance.
No recording device shall be used at Step 1, 2, or 3 of this procedure.
clauses.notes: General prohibition on recording at grievance steps.

clauses.quote: No person shall be present at any of these steps for the purpose of recording the discussion.
At Step 3, there shall be a single chief spokesperson on each side
this shall not preclude any participant at Step 3 from speaking.

DCPS shall comply with grievance settlements and arbitration awards within 60 days of the effective date of the completion of the settlement or receipt of the arbitrator's award and submission of all necessary paperwork submitted by the employee.
The Parties shall conduct joint training for all Teachers and Supervisors on the content of this Agreement and conflict resolution.

This training shall be conducted as a part of the ongoing professional development program by the Director of Human Resources or his/her designee, the General Counsel of DCPS or his/her designee(s) and the President of the WTU or his/her designee(s).
The joint training shall be conducted once each year, within the first three months of the School Year under the auspices of the FEP.

At the discretion of the WTU, any grievance concerning discipline, and/or discharge (including discharges that are evaluation related to violations of the evaluation process), may be initiated at Step 2 of this grievance procedure.
clauses.subject_text: any grievance concerning discipline, and/or discharge (including discharges that are evaluation related to violations of the evaluation process)

clauses.quote: The parties shall establish a joint grievance committee to meet once monthly to accomplish the following:
The Joint Grievance Committee shall have the discretion to intervene in schools where the data indicates that the most grievances are filed.
This committee shall operate under the auspices of the FEP.
